detaileddescription.para: Represents a ZMQ connection identifier. ZMQ identities are sent by router sockets and used to keep track of and send responses to specific clients. ZMQ connection IDs are always 5 bytes
Custom ZMQ "connection identities". Used for when the telemetry module or the GUI requests data from a module (vs. an external connection)
